news.title: CFTC’s new crypto framework could face 2028 election deadline, says TD Cowen
news.summary: Newly proposed rules for leveraged and margined crypto trading may be too late as the 2028 election cycle looms, according to TD Cowen.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
news.summary: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.

news.title: Binance launches AI trading tool after 150,000-user beta
news.summary: Binance rolled out Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users after a beta with about 150,000 testers.

news.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
news.summary: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

news.title: StoneX raises Securitize price target 50% as tokenized stock platform opens new revenue stream
news.summary: StoneX lifts SECZ price target to $18 from $12, citing new revenue from the Securitize Stocks tokenized trading platform on Solana.

news.title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
news.summary: The Bitcoin mining industry needs roughly $50 billion to complete planned AI infrastructure projects, with IREN, Riot Platforms and HIVE Digital facing major funding gaps.

news.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
news.summary: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

news.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
news.summary: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

news.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
news.summary: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

news.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
news.summary: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

news.title: DeFi Development grows SOL holdings 12% as CHAD hits record highs
news.summary: DFDV added 22,070 SOL last week, lifting holdings to 2.59 million SOL, as its CHAD preferred stock hit record highs despite a selloff.

news.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
news.summary: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

news.title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
news.summary: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.

news.title: Bitmine adds 12,532 ETH as Tom Lee flags potential ‘largest-ever’ crypto bull market
news.summary: Bitmine (BMNR) added 12,532 ETH last week, lifting its Ethereum treasury to 6.03 million tokens, or 4.9% of supply, with 84% staked.

news.title: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
news.summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy said Bitcoin holdings reached 848,250 BTC after its latest purchase, while maintaining a $4.88 billion cash reserve.

news.title: ‘There’s always room for more orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy scoops up another 250 bitcoin for $21.5 million as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
news.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $71 billion.

news.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
news.summary: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

news.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
news.summary: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

news.title: Evernorth names former Coinbase investment exec to steer 473 million XRP treasury ahead of Nasdaq debut
news.summary: Evernorth plans to put its XRP holdings to work through lending, liquidity provision and yield strategies.

news.title: Australia proposes leverage caps for crypto-settled derivatives
news.summary: ASIC’s proposal would extend leverage limits and protections against negative balances to certain derivatives settled in digital assets.

news.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
news.summary: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

news.title: BTC price support holds ahead of US CPI data: Three things Bitcoin traders need to know this week
news.summary: Bitcoin traders braced for inflation-based volatility after BTC price action preserved key weekly support around $82,500.

news.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
news.summary: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

news.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
news.summary: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

news.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
news.summary: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

news.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
news.summary: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

news.title: Morgan Stanley expects to support tokenized equities in Q1 2027, digital asset strategy head says
news.summary: Morgan Stanley is actively building the necessary infrastructure for tokenized equities while monitoring industry developments.

news.title: Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
news.summary: Payward received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA to expand its digital asset services in the UAE, building on the preliminary approval received in May.

news.title: Standard Chartered launches custody for Ripple’s RLUSD on XRP Ledger
news.summary: The bank is working with Ripple and LMAX Group to enable RLUSD as collateral for certain LMAX products under its collateral mirroring model.

news.title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
news.summary: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

news.title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
news.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

news.title: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
news.summary: Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.

news.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
news.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.

news.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
news.summary: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

news.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
news.summary: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.

news.title: DATA Network to migrate to Sui, retire own chain
news.summary: The migration is backed by a $30 million investment from Sui Foundation.

news.title: Bitcoin pulls back from $84,000 as oil recovers, ETFs bleed over $600 million
news.summary: Bitcoin reversed early gains as oil bounced back to over $92. Analysts express concerns over large outflows from spot ETFs last week.

news.title: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
news.summary: Holders could face fines of up to 10,000 euros for failing to declare qualifying assets.

news.title: Former Acting Chair Caroline Pham says CFTC can regulate almost everything except ‘onions and box office receipts’
news.summary: Pham said the CFTC's recent proposals are 'absolutely the kind of protection' needed for crypto retail traders in the United States.

news.title: Sui Foundation invests $30 million in DATA Network as AI data protocol migrates to Sui
news.summary: DATA Network is set to be upgraded to run as a protocol natively on Sui, and its independent chain will be retired.

news.title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
news.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.

news.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
news.summary: An user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a “$94 billion” XRP bug — but receive just a $250K bounty.

news.title: Trader nets $1.28 million on new 1,000x exchange Papertrade by moving Hyperliquid’s ETH prices
news.summary: The same wallet later lost $450,000 when 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night after staying open for more than three hours.

news.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
news.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

news.title: XRP Ledger patches decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP
news.summary: An overflow bug in the XRP Ledger's payment engine could have let an attacker mint about 18 trillion spendable XRP in one transaction.

news.title: Saylor teases Strategy Bitcoin buying after ending September with STRC buybacks
news.summary: Investors will have to wait an extra day to find out if and how much Strategy added to its Bitcoin treasury in the first week of October.

news.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
news.summary: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

news.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
news.summary: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

news.title: IMF finds demand for tokenized stocks, says the market is still volatile, illiquid
news.summary: Investors are using blockchain-based shares for smaller and after-hours trades. The IMF says liquidity, legal rules and settlement systems have not caught up.

news.title: Coldcard says it’s investigating how phishing link appeared on its X account
news.summary: Company advised users not to visit or interact with the link in question and said it will share any further verified updates.

news.title: Ledger confirms unauthorized hardware implant, says losses may exceed $86M
news.summary: Ledger said the incident appeared to be isolated to a single reseller and its Southeast Asian market.

news.title: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling
news.summary: The two measures attempt to set the stage for a potential US Supreme Court battle over federal and state jurisdiction.

news.title: Kalshi is investigating bets on Trump’s press secretary pick placed before announcement: WSJ
news.summary: Three bets totaling about $173 were placed before news outlets reported Zacharia's pick and are expected to pay out roughly $9,600 combined.

news.title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
news.summary: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows following last week's trading, a notable shift for some of the funds.

news.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

news.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
news.summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

news.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
news.summary: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.

news.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
news.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

news.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
news.summary: Recent incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic stoke global concerns and fears that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

news.title: Sam Altman-backed Bitcoin life insurer, Meanwhile, raises more funds
news.summary: The round follows increased international demand for Meanwhile’s Bitcoin life insurance policies amid broader macro instability.

news.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
news.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

news.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
news.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

news.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
news.summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

news.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
news.summary: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.

news.title: Former FTX COO says Netflix’s ‘Altruists’ trailer ‘made me physically throw up’
news.summary: Former FTX COO Constance Wang says Netflix's "The Altruists" misrepresents FTX's collapse and turns it into a love story.

news.title: Blockchain.com seeks CFTC greenlight for US prediction markets, crypto derivatives trading: CNBC
news.summary: Blockchain.com has applied for DCM and FCM licenses to offer ahead of a planned $500 million IPO.

news.title: Ledger investigates wallet drains involving CryptoBilis buyers; estimate tops $86 million in losses
news.summary: Ledger said it is investigating reports of fund losses from users in Southeast Asia who bought its products from reseller CryptoBilis.

news.title: US targets $1 billion Iran-linked crypto seizure, Bessent says ‘we know where it is’
news.summary: Bessent’s latest crypto seizure plan follows months of sanctions and freezes targeting Iranian assets.

news.title: New York AG secures up to $35 million from former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
news.summary: NY AG Letitia James secured up to $35M from ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky and a permanent ban from the securities and crypto industries.
